about.aboutMeContent1: I'm someone who never gives up.
about.aboutMeContent2: Building on my many experiences, I try never to stop taking on challenges. And I don't stop at just starting them — I keep developing with the goal of seeing every challenge through to the end.
about.devContent: Since I've mostly worked on the web, I enjoy handling both frontend and backend. I'm not an expert yet, but within AI I'm especially interested in computer vision.
about.photoContent: I love capturing the world in a small frame through photos and videos. I'm into it enough to do everything from shooting to color grading and video editing.
about.goal1Desc: Instead of building what everyone else builds, I want to start from what I need, what bothers me, and what I'm curious about — and become a developer who brings positive value to everyone.
about.goal2Desc: I want to be a developer the world needs — not one who only codes, or one stuck inside a box.
about.heroSubtitle: I want to build the life and the world I dream of!
